goal: Define release-grade capability coverage gate contract.
risk: AOF may overclaim that ingestion contract proves actual external validation or approval.
loss_boundary: Do not call v10.7 complete if it implies actual external validation, third-party validation completion, or market proof.
evidence_plan: release docs, capability delta, requirement coverage, work execution packet, Council review, runtime audits
stop_conditions: Stop if live provider execution is implied
Stop if production safety is claimed from structural evidence alone
